title: 4: Drainage Systems and Water Resource of Ethiopia and the Horn
content:
**ወደ ቻፕተር_4 እንኳን ደህና መጣችሁ! 

በዚህ ምዕራፍ የኢትዮጵያን የውሃ ሀብት፣ የወንዞች ፍሰት እና ዋና ዋና የፍሳሽ ገበታዎችን (Drainage Basins) በዝርዝር እናያለን። ይህ ኖት **በሞጁሉ መሠረት በግልጽ እና በዝርዝር** የተዘጋጀ ስለሆነ ለፈተናችሁ ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚያዘጋጃችሁ ይሆናል! ተከታተሉኝ📚💡

**1. World Water Distribution (የዓለማችን የውሃ ስርጭት)**
• **71%** of the earth's surface is covered by water bodies (seas & oceans).
• **97.5%** of earth's total water is **Alkaline/Salty** (በባህርና በውቅያኖሶች ይገኛል).
• Only **2.5%** is **Fresh Water** (ጥሩ/ለእጅ የሚሆን ንጹህ ውሃ).

**Where is Fresh Water deposited? (የንጹህ ውሃ ስርጭት breakdown):**
• **Glaciers (በረዶዎች):** **68.7%**
• **Groundwater (የከርሰ ምድር ውሃ):** **30.1%**
• **Permafrost:** **0.8%**
• **Surface Waters (የገጽታ ላይ ውሃ):** **0.4%** (In lakes, rivers, atmosphere, soils, and wetlands).

**2. Water Potential of Ethiopia (የኢትዮጵያ የውሃ ሀብት)**
• **0.7%** of Ethiopia's total landmass is covered by water bodies.
• Estimated surface water potential: **124.4 Billion Cubic Meters (BCM)**.
• Due to its diverse topography, high rainfall, and near-equator position, Ethiopia is called the **"Water Tower of Eastern Africa"** (የምስራቅ አፍሪካ የውሃ ማማ).

🎯 **Exam Hint:** ፈተና ላይ የFresh Water ስርጭት ፐርሰንቴጅ (Glaciers 68.7%, Groundwater 30.1%) እና የኢትዮጵያ Surface Water potential (**124.4 BCM**) በተደጋጋሚ ይጠየቃሉ! ያዙ።

title: የፍሳሽ ስርአት ፅንሰ-ሀሳብ (Concepts of Drainage Systems)
content:
የወንዞችን ፍሰት ከመማራችን በፊት ዋና ዋና መሠረታዊ ቃላትን (Key Terms) እንረዳ፦

**Key Terminology:**
• **Drainage (ፍሳሽ):** The flow of water through well-defined channels.
• **Drainage System:** A principal river and its tributaries (ዋና ወንዝ እና ገባሮቹ).
• **River Source/Headwater:** The starting place of a river system.
• **River Mouth:** The end point where a river flows into another body of water.
• **Drainage Basin (የወንዝ ገበታ):** The topographic region from which a river and its tributaries collect surface runoff and subsurface flow.
• **Water Divide / Topographic Divide:** Bounding high land that separates one river basin from another.

**Determinants of Ethiopian River Patterns (የኢትዮጵያ ወንዞች አቅጣጫ ወሳኞች):**
1. **Topography of outward sloping:** Western and Southeastern plateaus.
2. **Structural formation of the Rift Valley:** Inward-sloping escarpments resulting in an inland drainage system.
3. **Faults and joints:** Structurally influence part of the courses of many rivers.

**The Three Major Drainage Systems in Ethiopia:**
Ethiopia is classified into **3 main drainage systems** based on topography and geology:
1. **Western Drainage System** (ምዕራባዊ የፍሳሽ ስርአት)
2. **Southeastern Drainage System** (ደቡብ-ምስራቃዊ የፍሳሽ ስርአት)
3. **Rift Valley Drainage System** (የስምጥሸለቆ የፍሳሽ ስርአት)

title: 1. ምዕራባዊ የፍሳሽ ስርአት (The Western Drainage System)
content:
ይህ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ **ትልቁ** የፍሳሽ ስርአት ነው!

**General Characteristics:**
• Covers **40%** of the country's total land area.
• Carries **60%** of the annual water flow (ትልቁን የውሃ መጠን ይይዛል).
• Coextends with the westward sloping Western Highlands and Lowlands.

**Comprises 4 Major River Basins:**
1. **Abay Basin (ዓባይ)**
   • **Largest river** in both volumetric discharge and coverage.
   • Area: **199,812 km²**.
   • Carries **65%** of the annual flow of the western region.
   • Origin: Lake Tana (or Sekela / Choke Mountain).
   • Length: ~**1,450 km** before joining White Nile in Khartoum, Sudan.
   • Main tributaries: Dabus, Dedessa, Fincha, Guder, Muger, Jema, Beshilo, and Ghilgel Abay (the largest stream entering Tana).

2. **Tekeze Basin (ተከዜ)**
   • Area: **82,350 km²** (Table: 87,733 km²).
   • Annual flow: **8.2 BMC** (12% of the western region flow).
   • Main tributaries: **Angereb and Goang** (originate in central highlands).
   • Termed **Atbara** in Sudan.

3. **Baro-Akobo Basin (ባሮ-አኮቦ)**
   • Area: **75,912 km²**.
   • Annual flow: **23.6 BMC** (or 23.23 BMC) — carries **17%** of western flow.
   • Drains the wettest highlands in SW Ethiopia.
   • In its lower course, flows across an extensive marshy land.
   • Forms the **Sobat River** in South Sudan.

4. **Ghibe / Omo Basin (ጊቤ / オモ)**
   • Area: **79,000 km²** | Annual flow: **16.6 BMC** (6% of western flow).
   • **Unique feature:** Unlike Abay, Tekeze, and Baro (which flow West to the Mediterranean), Ghibe/Omo **flows Southward**!
   • Empties into **Lake Turkana (Chew-Bahir)**, forming an **Inland Drainage**.

🎯 **Exam Hint:** Abay, Tekeze, and Baro end at the **Mediterranean Sea via the Nile**, while Ghibe/Omo ends at **Lake Turkana (Inland)**!

title: 2. ደቡብ-ምስራቃዊ የፍሳሽ ስርአት (The Southeastern Drainage System)
content:
ይህ ስርአት የኢትዮጵያን ደቡብ-ምስራቅ አቅጣጫ የሚሸፍን ሲሆን ወንዞቹ ወደ **Indian Ocean (ህንድ ውቅያኖስ)** ይፈሳሉ።

**General Characteristics:**
• Mainly drained by **Wabishebelle** and **Ghenale / Dawa**.
• Slopes south-eastwards across water-deficient plains.
• Carries **25%** of the total annual water flow of Ethiopia.

**The Major Basins:**
1. **Ghenale Dawa Basin (ገናሌ ዳዋ)**
   • Area: **171,042 km²** | Annual flow: **5.8 BMC** (or 6 BMC in table).ሁለቱንም ያስቀመጥሁላችሁ ሞጅሉ በሁለቱም ስለሚገልጠው ምናልባት Choice ከመጣ Especific value ብቻ እንዳትጠብቁና approximation value ከተሠጣችሁም እንድትጠቀሙት ነዉ።
   • Tributaries: Dawa, Weyb, Welmel, Mena.
   • Has fewer tributaries than Wabishebelle, but **carries more water**.
   • Crosses border into Somalia and is named the **Juba River**, successfully reaching the **Indian Ocean**.

2. **Wabishebelle Basin (ዋቢሸበሌ)**
   • Area: **202,697 km²** — **The LARGEST catchment area** in Ethiopia!
   • **Longest river in Ethiopia**.
   • Tributaries: Ramis, Erer, Daketa, Fafan (mostly intermittent/seasonal left-bank tributaries).
   • Annual flow: **3.4 BMC**.
   • **Crucial Exam Point:** Despite being the longest and largest catchment, Wabishebelle **FAILS to reach the Indian Ocean**! Water disappears in the sands of Somalia near the Juba River.

🎯 **Exam Hint:** 
• Longest River / Largest Catchment Area = **Wabishebelle**
• River that reaches Indian Ocean = **Ghenale (Juba)**
• River that disappears in the sand = **Wabishebelle**

title: 3. የስምጥ-ሸለቆ የፍሳሽ ስርአት (The Rift Valley Drainage System)
content:
ይህ ስርአት አነስተኛ ዝናብ እና ከፍተኛ ትነነ (Evaporation) ያለበት የሀገሪቱ ክፍል ነው።

**General Characteristics:**
• Restricted catchment area bounded by inward-sloping Rift Valley escarpments.
• No single general flow direction (streams flow in all directions).
• Mostly forms **Inland Drainage Basins** (ወደ ውቅያኖስ የማይወጡ የውስጥ ፍሳሾች)።

**Sub-basins and Key Features:**
1. **Awash River Basin (አዋሽ)**
   • Catchment Area: **114,123 km²** | Annual discharge: **4.9 BMC**
   • Length: **1,250 km** (originates from Shewan Plateau).
   • **Most utilized river** in Ethiopia for commercial agriculture and hydro-power!
   • Flow direction: Northeast.
   • Terminus: Ends in a maze of small lakes/marshes; largest is **Lake Abe** on the Ethio-Djibouti border.
   • Tributaries: Akaki, Kesem, Borkena, Mile.

2. **Afar Drainage Sub-basin**
   • Practically **no stream flow** due to high temperatures and evaporation.
   • Lakes like **Lake Afrera** and **Lake Asale** are formed by **tectonic activities**, NOT surface river flow.

3. **Southern Rift Valley Lakes Region (የሐይቆች ቀጠና)**
   • Lakes occupy fault depressions fed by mountain streams:
     - **Meki and Katar Rivers** ➔ flow into **Lake Ziway**
     - **Bilate River** ➔ flows into **Lake Abaya**
     - **Segen River** ➔ flows into **Chew Bahir**
   • **Interconnected Lakes:**
     - Lake Ziway drains into Lake Abijiata via **Bulbula River**.
     - Lake Langano drains into Lake Abijiata via **Horocolo River**.

title: የኢትዮጵያ ወንዞች ንፅፅር ሰንጠረዥ (Summary Table of Ethiopian Rivers)
content:
በፈተና ላይ የሚመጡትን የ12ቱን ዋና ዋና ገበታዎች አጠቃላይ መረጃ በዚህ ሰንጠረዥ አጠናቅረንላችኋል 📊፦

| River (ወንዝ) | Catchment Area (km²) | Annual Volume (BMC) | Terminus / Mouth (መድረሻ) | Major Tributaries (ዋና ገባሮች) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Abay** | 199,812 | 54.5 (65% of West) | Mediterranean Sea | Dabus, Dedessa, Fincha, Guder, Muger, Jema, Beshilo |
| **Wabishebelle** | 202,697 | 3.4 | Sands of Somalia (Indian Ocean coast) | Ramis, Erer, Daketa, Fafan |
| **Ghenale Dawa** | 171,042 | 6.0 | Indian Ocean (Juba) | Dawa, Weyb, Welmel, Mena |
| **Awash** | 114,123 | 4.9 | Inland (Lake Abe) | Akaki, Kesem, Borkena, Mile |
| **Tekeze** | 87,733 | 8.2 | Mediterranean Sea (Atbara) | Goang, Angereb |
| **Ghibe (Omo)** | 79,000 | 16.6 | Lake Turkana (Inland) | Gojeb |
| **Baro Akobo** | 75,912 | 23.23 | Mediterranean Sea (Sobat) | Akobo |

🎯 **Fast Recap for Exam:**
1. **Largest Area:** Wabishebelle (202,697 km²)
2. **Highest Volume:** Abay(54.5 BMC) & Baro-Akobo (23.23 BMC) 
3. **Most Utilized:** Awash River
